body:
First-touch grading (triage seat): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `domain:devx` + `ci/cd`, type Bug. Taken ahead of the backlog on merge-queue-health grounds: an ejection re-builds every PR behind it, so the cost lands on every lane, and the signature is structurally invisible to the same-signature aggregator (no test file to key on).

Dispatch shape, measure-first: (1) quantify — of the ~71 queue failures in the last 24h, how many died in `Verify pnpm version` / carry the Corepack-download + undici `assert(!this.paused)` signature; (2) remedy is CI provisioning, dev's engineering call with PM review — the structural defect is a network download of pnpm in every job of every queue build, so candidates are caching/pre-provisioning the pnpm tarball (actions cache or `packageManager`-aware setup-node caching) or pinning a provisioning path that doesn't re-download per job. ⛔ Do not add this signature to the flaky ledger (human escalation only, per the card) and do not touch test code — the fix is in workflow provisioning steps (`ci.yml:294` and the sibling pairs). If measurement shows the signature is a one-off, `premise_still_valid: false` with the count is a legal delivery.
